description.value: Subway is an independently owned and operated sandwich franchise located in Clearwater, BC, offering made-to-order Footlongs, 6" sandwiches, wraps, salads, and breakfast items. Customers can order in-restaurant, via delivery, or through curbside pickup, and catering is also available. Clearwater sits along a major touring corridor and this location provides a convenient, reliable food stop with accepted credit cards and flexible ordering options.
